intro: Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore holds a cleverly encrypted letter, and he knows someone in Ironforge who might decrypt it. He sends you with the letter to Prospector Stormpike, in the Library of the Hall of Explorers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a colleague in Ironforge who may be able to help decrypt this letter. Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge and speak with Prospector Stormpike. Tell him I sent you and show him the letter. If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Dibbs from Southshore sent you, did he? How is the old bookworm doing?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, encryption! A specialty of mine. Let me see here...
